charts.title: Native smooth-clock position by acquisition cutoff
charts.caption: Eight authentic recordings are replayed with independent causal sample-counter prefixes and unchanged capture-start TLEs. Two recordings also replay exact omitted offers. Forced points show fit diagnostics.

charts.title: Stable online stop and complete native acquisition
charts.caption: The stop rule takes the second agreeing published prefix once shared orbital support has new measurements. At the 300-second deadline the ordinary position gate applies. The terminal control includes every scheduled visit.
